diagnostic_program: Inspect existing phase-local timings and queue observations under a fixed request cohort
If still unresolved, select a supported prefill-related intervention with explicit confounder accounting
skills.support_predicate: Declare from measured phase response and repeated evidence; no default threshold is claimed
skills.contradiction_predicate: Observed response conflicts with the prespecified expectation
skills.inconclusive_predicate: Unavailable observations, material confounders, or effect uncertainty
skills.restoration: Restore the recorded complete configuration and declared cache/warm-up policy

diagnostic_program: Inspect actual output lengths, local decode timing, active sequences, and available admission signals
Choose a supported decode-limit intervention only after defining controlled inputs and resource changes
skills.support_predicate: Use local and end-to-end evidence separately; utilization alone is insufficient
skills.contradiction_predicate: Repeated observations oppose the declared response
skills.inconclusive_predicate: Cannot distinguish capacity, admission, and upstream effects
skills.restoration: Restore the recorded configuration and drain outstanding requests according to the protocol

diagnostic_program: Measure stage observations and end-to-end attainment on declared legal allocations
Compare isolated-capacity recommendations with measured full-service decisions
skills.support_predicate: Record which allocation changes improve feasibility or service capacity and their resource costs
skills.contradiction_predicate: Predicted ranking does not match independently measured ranking
skills.inconclusive_predicate: Ranking uncertainty, unstable queue, or incomplete timing
skills.restoration: Return resources to the reservation ledger and restore the incumbent deployment

diagnostic_program: Compare isolated transfer, isolated compute, and supported concurrent operation
Match payload, compute work, placement, and measurement semantics; repeat and record confounders
skills.support_predicate: A prespecified concurrent response is repeatable with compatible independent evidence
skills.contradiction_predicate: The expectation fails under a valid matched probe
skills.inconclusive_predicate: No supported isolation, unmatched work, or uncertain external interference
skills.restoration: Stop probes, restore transfer settings and worker placement, apply the declared warm-up policy
